rootCauseOneLine: The Automations "New automation" button is a create-via-chat handoff (navigate.toCompose with initialPrompt "Create a new bb automation to ") that nothing in the UI explains, and because the SDK bridge sends no replaceInitialPrompt the seed is applied via restorePromptDraftIfEmpty and silently dropped whenever a New thread draft already exists — so the click lands on a bare New thread composer.
proposedFix: (1) Let the automations plugin make its seed authoritative: add an opt-in to useBbNavigate().toCompose (experimental_ prefixed per AGENTS.md) or always set replaceInitialPrompt when initialPrompt is non-empty, matching the Skills "New skill" button, and use it from createViaChat in plugins/automations/app.tsx (app-only, no daemon protocol bump; consider not clobbering a non-create draft). (2) Explain the handoff: relabel/tooltip the button or render a callout on the composer when it was seeded by a create action ("bb will ask an agent to create this automation…"), using the existing but dead createDraftKind state. (3) Optionally add a small direct-create dialog calling the existing automations_create RPC. (4) Keep the provided vitest as a regression test.
caveats: The issue is one line with no version or comments; there is no literal "Create automation" label in the app, so I treated it as the "New automation" button on the Automations page. Repro test asserts the intended behaviour (seed visible despite an existing draft) and fails on main; the "seed dropped" mechanism is a confirmed code path, while the empty-draft case is working-as-designed but unexplained UX. Worktree HEAD was origin/main (a108fa7ef) at start; I checked out 16ceb3a54 for all evidence. The repro test file is left untracked in the worktree at apps/app/src/components/plugin/Issue1776NewAutomationSeed.repro.test.tsx.
